entities.summary: Nomaza Nongqunga Coupez is a South African–French cultural entrepreneur, curator and consultant. She is the founder of Undiscovered Canvas, a boutique agency promoting contemporary African artists in Europe, and of the Makwande Art Residency, an initiative supporting African women artists. She previously served on France's Presidential Council for Africa (2017–2018).
